# Constance Chan | Johor Bahru Property Agent

> Constance Chan (PEA3963) is a property agent at The Roof Realty (E(1)1605/1) in Johor Bahru, Malaysia, practising since 2020. She helps homeowners, investors and tenants buy, sell and rent residential, commercial and industrial property in Johor Bahru and nearby areas.

This site lists her current properties for sale and for rent, recently sold and rented deals, free price estimate and buyer/tenant enquiry forms, a mortgage repayment calculator, an FAQ, and client reviews from Google. Listings are refreshed daily from her NextSix profile.
